newsitem.title: UK: BFI falls 13 points, Panamax rates ease.
newsitem.headline: BFI falls 13 points, Panamax rates ease.

text.p: The spot Baltic Freight Index (BFI) fell 13 points on Monday to 1,430, even though Caper rates remained generally steady, brokers said.
However, Panamax levels continued to fall in the Atlantic and the Pacific.
Halla was reported to have fixed 54,000 tonnes HSS U.S. Gulf/Japan for March/April at $24.00 no combo (down 25 cents from last done).
Continental fixed Mass Enterprise 54,000 HSS Nopac/Taiwan for March 7/15 at a much weaker $13.85. --London Newsroom 44 171 542 8080
